carpet.rule.infiniteBuckets.desc: Water and lava buckets can be enchanted with Infinity, and Infinity buckets are not consumed when used
carpet.rule.rightClickHarvest.desc: Right-clicking a mature crop harvests it and replants it in one step, consuming one seed
carpet.rule.boneMealCatalyst.desc: Bone meal also grows sugar cane, cactus, nether wart and vines, consuming one bone meal per use
carpet.rule.afkPlayerProtection.desc: Idle players and Carpet fake players are immune to suffocation, lightning, fall damage and phantoms
carpet.rule.autoEatAfk.desc: Idle players and fake players automatically eat food from their inventory when their hunger drops below the threshold
carpet.rule.autoEatAfkTarget.desc: Who is fed: fakePlayers (Carpet bots), trueplayer (real players only) or all
carpet.rule.autoEatAfkThreshold.desc: Food level (0-20) that triggers automatic eating
carpet.rule.autoEatAfkFoods.desc: Allowed foods: * for any food, or a comma separated list of item ids
carpet.rule.betterLead.desc: A lead renamed to the configured lasso name captures a mob on right-click and releases it when used on a block
carpet.rule.betterLeadName.desc: Item name that turns a lead into a lasso
carpet.rule.rtsRecipes.desc: Allows the crafting recipes shipped by this mod to be used
